label: Calm
description: Glassy to rippled sea. No impact on port operations.

label: Light Breeze
description: Small wavelets. Normal port operations for all vessel types.

label: Moderate
description: Moderate waves. Small craft may be affected.

label: Rough
description: Large waves forming. Small craft advisories possible.

label: Very Rough
description: Heaping seas with white foam. Gale-force winds.

label: Storm
description: Very high waves. Dangerous for all but large vessels.
